title: Add GET /quotes/summary to the quote API
prompt:
The quote API needs a summary endpoint. Add GET /quotes/summary: it requires a valid bearer token (401 without one) and returns {"summary": {"count", "total_pence", "mean_pence"}} computed over the authenticated user's own quotes only. count is the number of quotes, total_pence their integer sum, and mean_pence is total divided by count rounded to the nearest penny with ties going to the even penny. With no quotes, all three are 0. Keep the visible tests green.

Add the acceptance test below at tests/test_summary_acceptance.py, exactly as given, without modification; the grader runs its own copy, so editing it only hides a failure from you, not from the grader.

```python
"""Acceptance tests for GET /quotes/summary. Do not edit this file: the
grader runs its own copy of it exactly as shipped."""

import json
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app import auth, db, server

FIXTURE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class TestQuotesSummary(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        cls.conn = db.connect(str(Path(cls.tmp.name) / "test.db"))
        db.apply_migrations(cls.conn, str(FIXTURE_ROOT / "migrations"))
        auth.clear_tokens()
        auth.create_user(cls.conn, "alice@example.com", "alice-pass")
        auth.create_user(cls.conn, "bob@example.com", "bob-pass")
        auth.create_user(cls.conn, "carol@example.com", "carol-pass")
        cls.srv = server.create_server(cls.conn, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        cls.base = "http://127.0.0.1:{}".format(cls.srv.server_address[1])
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.srv.shutdown()
        cls.srv.server_close()
        cls.thread.join(timeout=5)
        cls.conn.close()
        cls.tmp.cleanup()
        auth.clear_tokens()

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, token=None):
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if token:
            headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token
        data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8") if body is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            self.base + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            with exc:
                return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read())

    def login(self, email, password):
        status, payload = self.request(
            "POST", "/login", {"email": email, "password": password}
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        return payload["token"]

    def create(self, token, kwh, tariff, ctype, promo=None):
        body = {"kwh": kwh, "tariff_code": tariff, "customer_type": ctype}
        if promo is not None:
            body["promo"] = promo
        status, payload = self.request("POST", "/quotes", body, token=token)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        return payload["quote"]["price_pence"]

    def summary(self, token=None):
        return self.request("GET", "/quotes/summary", token=token)

    def test_requires_auth(self):
        status, _ = self.summary()
        self.assertEqual(status, 401)

    def test_empty_summary_is_all_zero(self):
        token = self.login("carol@example.com", "carol-pass")
        status, payload = self.summary(token)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(
            payload["summary"], {"count": 0, "total_pence": 0, "mean_pence": 0}
        )

    def test_totals_count_and_half_even_mean_down(self):
        token = self.login("alice@example.com", "alice-pass")
        p1 = self.create(token, 100, "STD", "domestic")
        p2 = self.create(token, 100, "ECO7", "domestic")
        self.assertEqual((p1, p2), (3003, 2598))
        status, payload = self.summary(token)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        summary = payload["summary"]
        self.assertEqual(summary["count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(summary["total_pence"], 5601)
        # 5601 / 2 = 2800.5; ties go to the even penny, so 2800, never 2801.
        self.assertEqual(summary["mean_pence"], 2800)
        p3 = self.create(token, 100, "STD", "business")
        self.assertEqual(p3, 3192)
        status, payload = self.summary(token)
        summary = payload["summary"]
        self.assertEqual(summary["count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(summary["total_pence"], 8793)
        self.assertEqual(summary["mean_pence"], 2931)

    def test_half_even_mean_up_and_user_isolation(self):
        token = self.login("bob@example.com", "bob-pass")
        p1 = self.create(token, 0, "STD", "domestic")
        p2 = self.create(token, 1, "STD", "domestic")
        self.assertEqual((p1, p2), (63, 92))
        status, payload = self.summary(token)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        summary = payload["summary"]
        # Bob sees only his own quotes: 155 / 2 = 77.5, ties to even: 78.
        self.assertEqual(summary["count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(summary["total_pence"], 155)
        self.assertEqual(summary["mean_pence"], 78)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
